decision: The best of 300 random subsets selected on disjoint calibration MLPs has selection MSE 1.15976e-05, +107.75% versus direct 4096 RQMC, and adjusted score 1.15976e-06, +268.43% versus K3. It fails the development gate. Random partition search should stop; best-of-many oracle values are selection bias rather than a usable rule.
